# lmw post reply

Reply to a comment (asks for confirmation)

### Synopsis

Reply to a comment on a post. COMMENT is the comment's URN, as
`lmw post comments` shows it (urn:li:fsd_comment:(...)).

Like comments, replies are never retried: if LinkedIn reports an error, look
at the post before trying again.

```
lmw post reply COMMENT [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw post reply "urn:li:fsd_comment:(7001,urn:li:activity:7123456789012345678)" --text "Thanks!"
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help               help for reply
      --text string        reply text
      --text-file string   file with the reply text
```
